name: titaniaann/makerhearth-architecture
description: A reference implementation of the multi-tenant studio-management architecture behind MakerHearth. Demonstrates immutable ledgers with computed balances, strictly-forward state machines, benefit resolution across sources, snapshot-on-purchase pricing, the single order-paid contract, refund decision-vs-movement, and banker's-rounding money math — extracted from the production Laravel platform into a small, framework-free PHP package.
